newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan issues tender to buy November naphtha.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan issues tender to buy November naphtha.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy heavy naphtha for delivery in November, a company official said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks 28,000 tonnes of naphtha for November 11-30 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) to Kaohsiung. The tender closes on October 8 and offers are valid until October 9.
In its previous tender, CPC bought 30,000 tonnes of heavy naphtha for October 21-31 delivery at around $200 per tonne on a c-and-f basis to Kaoshiung.
